title: Kerala moves Supreme Court against HC order restraining State Waqf Board from taking major decisions
description: The Kerala government has approached the Supreme Court against an order of the Kerala High Court restraining the State Waqf Board from taking any major decisions, incurring capital expenditure or making policy decisions The appeal was mentioned before Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana for urgent hearing.The CJI agreed to list the matter on July 20, Monday.Chief Justice Soumen Sen and Justice Syam Kumar VM (Kerala HC)A Division Bench of Chief Justic
